title: turath-catalog works
description: One row per work (a text by an author), whatever the number of its editions in the dataset.

work_id.description: Stable id: `w_` + first 10 hex digits of sha1(`title_key|author_key`).

title_ar.description: Title of the work in Arabic, as on the best-attested edition.

alt_titles_ar.description: Other titles of the work, `;`-separated (titles written «A = B» are split).

author_id.description: The work's author (authors.author_id). Empty for anonymous works and collections.

author_name_ar.description: The author's name as cited (denormalised from authors.name_ar for convenience).

category_ar.description: Subject category, one of the 40 categories of al-Maktaba al-Shamila.

openiti_uri.description: OpenITI book URI (2025.1.9 release) of the same work.

openiti_confidence.description: How the OpenITI link was made: `high` = same death year, same title, author name agrees; `medium` = same death year, one title is a prefix of the other (3+ words), author agrees.

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata item of the work, through the Wikidata item of a Shamela edition (P12239 → P629).

ext_ids.description: Other catalogs' ids for the work, `;`-separated `scheme:id` (scheme `shamela` = al-Maktaba al-Shamila book id).

n_editions.description: Number of editions of this work in the dataset.

confidence.description: Confidence of the work's identity (title and author): the best confidence among its editions.
